spans.text: This Privacy Policy applies to the USB Slideshow & Signage application for Roku devices and Roku TV devices (the "Application"). The Application is provided by Deepak PK (the "Service Provider") as a USB slideshow and digital signage utility for playing locally stored photos, videos, and optional audio from a USB drive on a TV.

USB Slideshow & Signage is designed primarily for local USB media playback on your Roku device. The Service Provider does not use Google Analytics, Firebase Analytics, Firebase Crashlytics, Google Play Services, or similar third-party analytics or advertising tracking services in the Roku version of the Application.
To provide the slideshow, signage, gallery, settings, subscription, support, and legal-page features, the Application may handle information such as:

items.text: Media files you choose to place on a USB drive and access with the Application, including photos, videos, and audio files

File and folder details available from the USB drive, such as file names, folder names, file paths, extensions, media type classification, thumbnails or placeholders, and related metadata when available
Playback and display preferences, such as slide interval, shuffle setting, selected background music, image display mode, background color, and gallery or playback state

Device and app settings information used inside the Application, such as display resolution, aspect ratio, subscription state, entitlement recovery state, app version, and temporary storage information

Temporary app data used to support USB scanning, gallery display, thumbnails, playback, background audio selection, subscriptions, help pages, legal pages, support pages, performance, and error recovery
Subscription, purchase, entitlement, catalog, recovery, renewal, expiration, or billing-status information made available through the Roku platform
Support or feedback information you choose to send through external support pages, feedback forms, email, or other linked resources

spans.text: This information is used to provide USB media discovery, gallery browsing, slideshow and signage playback, background music, saved settings, free-mode limits, subscription access control, support, troubleshooting, and related in-app features.

The Application is designed to read supported media from USB storage connected to your Roku device. The Roku version of the Application is not designed to upload your photos, videos, audio files, folders, or media library to a Service Provider cloud storage account.

Media remains on the USB drive unless the Roku platform or the Application temporarily caches data needed for normal operation, such as thumbnails, display state, or playback-related data. You are responsible for the contents of the USB drive and for removing any private or sensitive files you do not want accessible on your TV.

The Application may scan folders and subfolders on a connected USB drive to find supported image, video, and audio file extensions. Classification is based on file information such as names and extensions, and actual playback depends on Roku platform support, file condition, codec/container support, device resources, and app behavior.

blocks.text: Information the Application Does Not Collect for Tracking

spans.text: The Roku version of the Application does not use the Application to track your activity across apps or websites. The Service Provider does not use the Application to collect analytics events, advertising identifiers, precise location information, or behavioral tracking information for profiling or targeted advertising.

blocks.text: Network, Hosted Content, and External Resources

spans.text: Local USB playback does not require a Service Provider media server. However, internet or network access may be used for Roku subscription catalog, purchase, entitlement, and recovery features; Help/FAQ, Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, and other hosted content; support pages; feedback forms; and platform services. When these resources are loaded, the Roku platform, hosting provider, form provider, social platform, or other external service may receive normal technical information such as request, device, browser, app, network, or account information according to their own policies.

The Application may offer free access with media listing, playback, or feature limits and may offer subscription features through the Roku platform. Subscription purchases, renewals, cancellations, entitlement checks, entitlement recovery, payment handling, refunds, and billing account management are handled by Roku and are subject to Roku's policies and terms. The Service Provider may receive or use entitlement status and related subscription information made available by Roku to enable subscription-related features inside the Application.

The Application may keep temporary app data on the Roku device to support USB scanning, gallery display, thumbnails, playback, background audio, settings, subscriptions, help/legal page loading, performance, and error recovery. Temporary app data may be cleared during normal app operation, when cached data is pruned, when the app restarts, when the USB drive changes, or through available app or Roku system controls.

The Service Provider does not intend for the Roku version of the Application to maintain a cloud-hosted user profile, upload your USB media to a Service Provider cloud service, or keep a remote analytics history of your media playback activity.

The Application may display settings and device-related information such as screen resolution, aspect ratio, selected display preferences, and app version. Help, FAQ, support, feedback, Privacy Policy, and Terms of Use pages may load hosted content or open external resources. If you contact support or submit feedback, the information you provide is handled according to the policies that apply to the relevant email service, form provider, social platform, or support resource.

The Roku version of the Application runs on the Roku platform and uses Roku platform features, including external storage access, media playback, registry storage, channel store, billing, catalog, and entitlement features where applicable. Your use of Roku devices, Roku accounts, Roku payments, and Roku services is also governed by Roku's own policies and terms.

The Application is not directed to children under 13, and the Service Provider does not knowingly use the Application to solicit personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided personal information through a support or feedback channel, please contact the Service Provider so reasonable steps can be taken to address it.

The Service Provider takes reasonable steps to avoid unnecessary collection of personal information in the Roku version of the Application. No app, device, network, storage medium, or transmission method can be guaranteed to be completely secure. You are responsible for keeping your Roku device, Roku account, USB drive, files, network, and any linked support or feedback accounts secure.

The Service Provider may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If that happens, the updated version will be posted at the current Privacy Policy page. Continued use of the Application after an update means you accept the updated Privacy Policy to the extent permitted by applicable law.
This Privacy Policy is effective as of 2026-10-08.
